core_obligations: Use the constancy of the relative dimension to produce the map over the local complete intersection locus, isomorphic at the smooth points (proof lines 7890-7904).
Apply the (S_2) property and the Hartog-type extension to spread the map to X (proof lines 7906-7912).

The extension by the (S_2) property (proof lines 7906-7912).
difficulty_reason: For a morphism f : X -> Y and r >= 0 with Y Cohen-Macaulay, f factoring as an immersion into a smooth proper scheme over Y, f Koszul at all points of X of dimension at most one, and the transcendence degree of kappa(xi) over kappa(f(xi)) equal to r at every generic point xi, the lemma asserts that with omega_{X/Y} = H^{-r}(f^!O_Y) there is a map wedge^r Omega_{X/Y} -> omega_{X/Y} which is an isomorphism on the smooth locus of f (statement lines 7844-7888). Letting U be the open locus where f is a local complete intersection morphism, assumption (4) makes the locally constant function of Lemma labelled lemma-fundamental-class-lci equal to r, giving a map wedge^r Omega_{U/Y} -> omega_{U/Y} = omega_{X/Y}|_U which is an isomorphism at the smooth points, a locus contained in U because smooth morphisms are local complete intersection (proof lines 7890-7904). By Lemma labelled lemma-shriek-over-CM and the Cohen-Macaulayness of Y the module omega_{X/Y} is (S_2); since U contains all points of codimension one by assumption (3), Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-depth-2-hartog gives j_*omega_{U/Y} = omega_{X/Y}, so the map over U extends to X and the proof is complete (proof lines 7906-7912). Using the (S_2) property to extend the comparison map from the codimension one locus to all of X is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
